item.title: Does locking up a student's cell phone improve test scores? A new study suggests so
item.description: A new study of school cellphone bans finds they may help students make up for some of the learning they've lost since 2013 – a divergence from earlier study results.

item.title: NPR's Student Podcast Challenge is back for 2027
item.description: The annual audio competition for grades four through 12 returns in January. Now in its ninth year, the contest has involved more than 90,000 students around the country.

item.title: New Mexico wanted free childcare for all. There's just one drawback
item.description: About a year ago, New Mexico became the first state to offer free childcare to every eligible family, regardless of income. One catch: The state doesn't have the capacity to meet the demand.

item.title: At least 23 states considered laws governing ICE and schools this year
item.description: When ICE agents show up at a school, educators rely on a patchwork of policies to know what to do. This year, many state legislatures tried to update those policies.
